en.headline: Mother arrested after 10-year-old left alone overnight in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: Police arrested a 43-year-old woman on suspicion of cruelty to a child after her grandfather found the girl alone at home in Lai Tsui Court; the child was taken to hospital for checks.
body: Police arrested a 43-year-old woman on Sunday on suspicion of cruelty or neglect of a child in her care after a 69-year-old man reported that his 10-year-old granddaughter had been left alone overnight in a flat at Lai Pak House, Lai Tsui Court in Cheung Sha Wan.

The man told officers he went to the unit around 10:27 a.m. intending to take the girl for breakfast and found her alone. He also alleged that the girl had been struck on an earlier occasion. Police said the case is being investigated as cruelty to a child or young person.

The girl was taken by ambulance to Caritas Medical Centre for checks. Under the Offences Against the Person Ordinance, a person over 16 who has care of a child under 16 and wilfully assaults, ill-treats, neglects or abandons the child can face up to 10 years in prison if convicted.

zh.headline: 長沙灣麗翠苑10歲女童通宵獨留家中 43歲母親涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 警方周日拘捕一名43歲女子，涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略；其69歲祖父發現孫女獨留麗柏閣單位，女童已送院檢查。
body: 警方周日接獲一名69歲男子報案，指其10歲孫女通宵被獨留在長沙灣麗翠苑麗柏閣一個住宅單位內，無人照顧。人員到場調查後，以涉嫌「對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略」拘捕女童的43歲母親。
報案男子表示，他早上約10時27分前往單位打算接孫女外出吃早餐，發現她獨留家中，並指稱女童早前曾被毆打。警方正調查案件。
涉事女童由救護車送往明愛醫院檢查。根據《侵害人身罪條例》第27條，任何超過16歲且對16歲以下兒童負有看管責任的人，若故意襲擊、虐待、忽略或遺棄該兒童，導致不必要苦楚或健康損害，一經定罪最高可判監禁10年。
